function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticate a user by their username and password, providing a token for successful authentication. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The username of the user attempting to log in.

password.description: The password for the specified username.

remember_me.description: Whether to create a persistent session for the user.

login_attempts.description: The number of consecutive failed login attempts for the user. After a certain threshold, additional security checks may be required.

last_login.description: The timestamp of the user's last successful login, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', such as '2023-01-15 13:45:00'.
